Our work

Quality construction is measured by the quality of life itself

HARJAS Builder and Contractor began in 1985 as a proprietorship, built on the skills of people experienced in building construction, solar and related fields. We bring the same passion to road and building projects today, and every project we take on is finished with the client satisfied and on schedule.

Our promise is quality, speed and service, with maximum value for minimum cost, efficient project management, and no compromise on schedules or budgets. We currently have projects in many locations in pan India, however remote or challenging.

    Why clients choose us

    How long have you been building?

    Since 1985. Over 40 years of experience in building construction, roads and solar energy.

    Do you handle government projects?

    Yes. We have completed government, semi-government and private projects, all delivered with client satisfaction and in time.

    Where do you work?

    We have projects across many locations pan-india and have built for clients in Jammu & Kashmir, Delhi and beyond.

    Do you build solar power plants?

    Yes. We were the first in India to generate electricity with solar, in 2008, and we continue to build solar energy projects.
